authorization.text: Sure let’s do the quick review and adjustments. Approved one-time review of current ratings with documented, evidence-supported adjustments; normal 90/10 continues.

scope: All 32 current team-strength ratings. Four conservative half-point judgment adjustments; hold 28 teams. Current QB, personnel, HFA and matchup layers remain independently governed.

method.amountSelection: Manual analyst judgment capped at half a point per selected team; not optimized or a validated rebase formula.
method.performanceReview: 93 verified final scores and 83 fully paired known-injury games; preserve archived location values. Compare preseason-regularized score diagnostics at lambda 2,4,6,10, current EPA, and ESPN FPI/efficiency.
method.mainPerformanceGuardrail: Prefer convergent healthy-strength evidence with a material primary diagnostic gap; strongest-prior sensitivity may counsel holding. The GB adjustment is separately labelled omitted-opener judgment, conservatively smaller than its raw retained sensitivity.
method.fullStrengthBoundary: Do not embed current temporary QB/personnel losses in carried ratings or convert public ranking differences into rating points.
method.historyBoundary: Original scores, predictions, seeds, historical events and 90/10 receipts are preserved. The ten missing Week 1 updates remain incomplete; this review does not recover them. Any later historical recovery must reconcile this explicit manual correction to avoid double counting.
method.futureLearning: Subsequent ordinary 90/10 updates start from these corrected current ratings with unchanged Walters arithmetic.
method.validationLimitation: Diagnostics are cross-checks, not new production models or established predictive improvements.

Later injury-normalized performances support strength, so adopt only half a point. EPA and efficiency provide review corroboration. This is not an exact Week 1 repair.
